title: 12 Best Craft Beer Bars in Ho Chi Minh City — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best craft beer bars in Ho Chi Minh City — curated from Reddit reviews. Heart of Darkness, Pasteur Street, East West Brewing, BiaCraft, 7 Bridges & more. Taproom guides, IPA picks, and honest verdicts.

places.name: Heart of Darkness Craft Brewery
places.address: 31D Lý Tự Trọng, Bến Nghé, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: I'm here for 5 days in Saigon. Craft beer lover, especially of IPAs. Been to Heart of Darkness brewery (quite good) and curious to know if there's any other must-visits.
redditQuotes.source: — r/CraftBeer · Craft breweries in Ho Chi Minh City thread

redditQuotes.text: Heart of Darkness is my personal favourite in Saigon where I found myself celebrating my birthday, working on my laptop with my favourite IPA by my side, having lunch and meeting friends. Somehow all roads led me there.
redditQuotes.source: — amatteroftaste.me · Craft Beer Bars in Saigon guide

places.verdict: The undisputed king of Saigon craft beer. Founded in 2016 by an American from NYC, Heart of Darkness is where serious hop heads go to worship. Twenty taps, a dark industrial taproom, and some of the best IPAs in Southeast Asia.

comparison.best for: IPA lovers, hop heads, and anyone who wants the best craft beer experience in Saigon
comparison.must-try: Kurtz's Insane IPA (7 hops, big punch), Loose Rivet NEIPA, Dream Alone Mosaic Pale Ale
comparison.vibe: Dark, industrial taproom with rock music — never Christmas songs. Large shaded patio + AC bar inside
comparison.why it made the list: Most mentioned craft beer spot across all Saigon Reddit threads. Consistently excellent IPAs, great seasonal rotation, and the kind of taproom atmosphere that makes you want to stay for hours.

places.insiderTip: Most mentioned craft beer spot across all Saigon Reddit threads. Consistently excellent IPAs, great seasonal rotation, and the kind of taproom atmosphere that makes you want to stay for hours.
places.editorialSummary: The undisputed king of Saigon craft beer. Founded in 2016 by an American from NYC, Heart of Darkness is where serious hop heads go to worship. Twenty taps, a dark industrial taproom, and some of the best IPAs in Southeast Asia.
places.bestFor: IPA lovers, hop heads, and anyone who wants the best craft beer experience in Saigon

places.name: Pasteur Street Brewing Co.

redditQuotes.text: Pasteur Street Craft Beer Ngô Thời Nhiệm — Premium Local Craft Beer in HCMC. 5/5 ⭐ — A Must-Visit for Craft Beer Lovers in Saigon!
redditQuotes.source: — Facebook Vietnam Travel Guide · Craft Beer Recommendation thread, 2025

redditQuotes.text: Pasteur Street is worth a visit. The original taproom on Pasteur Street with the small roof terrace tucked away in an inner courtyard is the perfect place to enjoy their hop-heavy Jasmine IPA.
redditQuotes.source: — r/VietNam · Bar recommendations in Ho Chi Minh thread

places.verdict: The pioneer that kicked off Vietnam's craft beer revolution in 2014. Pasteur Street uses fresh Vietnamese ingredients — jasmine, passion fruit, Vietnamese coffee — in genuinely creative beers you won't find anywhere else on Earth.

comparison.best for: Vietnamese-ingredient craft beers, unique flavor profiles, the OG Saigon brewery experience
comparison.must-try: Jasmine IPA, Passion Fruit Wheat Ale, Citra Pale Ale, seasonal Vietnamese coffee stout
comparison.vibe: Cozy rooftop terrace hidden in an alleyway courtyard — the original location on Pasteur Street is the best
comparison.why it made the list: Highest Google rating (4.8★) of any craft brewery in Saigon. Multiple taprooms across the city plus locations in Hanoi and Hoi An. The staff gets special mentions for friendliness.

places.insiderTip: Highest Google rating (4.8★) of any craft brewery in Saigon. Multiple taprooms across the city plus locations in Hanoi and Hoi An. The staff gets special mentions for friendliness.
places.editorialSummary: The pioneer that kicked off Vietnam's craft beer revolution in 2014. Pasteur Street uses fresh Vietnamese ingredients — jasmine, passion fruit, Vietnamese coffee — in genuinely creative beers you won't find anywhere else on Earth.
places.bestFor: Vietnamese-ingredient craft beers, unique flavor profiles, the OG Saigon brewery experience

places.name: East West Brewing Co.
places.address: 181 Lý Tự Trọng, Bến Thành, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: East West Brewing Company — their Coffee Vanilla Porter is a firm favorite of fellow patrons. In fact, it just might be best to get a Beer Flight so that you can sample all of their delicious brews!
redditQuotes.source: — JetsettingFools · 4 Outstanding Saigon Craft Breweries guide

places.verdict: The biggest and most polished brewery experience in Saigon. A modern industrial space with visible brewing equipment, a full restaurant, brewery tours, and a weekday happy hour. "Connecting Cultures through Craft Beer" isn't just a slogan — they genuinely blend European, North American, and Asian techniques.

comparison.best for: Groups, date nights, brewery tours, and anyone who wants food with their craft beer
comparison.must-try: Coffee Vanilla Porter (crowd favorite), Far East IPA, Mosaic Ale, beer flights to sample everything
comparison.vibe: Modern, spacious, industrial-chic. On-site restaurant with a broad menu. Events, happy hours, and brewery tours available
comparison.why it made the list: The full brewery experience — visible equipment, knowledgeable staff, and a beer lineup that covers every style. Their Coffee Vanilla Porter is a signature that non-beer-lovers also enjoy.

places.insiderTip: The full brewery experience — visible equipment, knowledgeable staff, and a beer lineup that covers every style. Their Coffee Vanilla Porter is a signature that non-beer-lovers also enjoy.
places.editorialSummary: The biggest and most polished brewery experience in Saigon. A modern industrial space with visible brewing equipment, a full restaurant, brewery tours, and a weekday happy hour. "Connecting Cultures through Craft Beer" isn't just a slogan — they genuinely blend European, North American, and Asian techniques.
places.bestFor: Groups, date nights, brewery tours, and anyone who wants food with their craft beer

places.name: BiaCraft

redditQuotes.text: Bia Craft in D2 was the spot to be when I was last there, though Pasteur Street is worth a visit.
redditQuotes.source: — r/CraftBeer · 14 different kinds of craft beer in Vietnam thread

redditQuotes.text: BiaCraft prides itself for the most extensive craft beer offer in the city. The salted egg yolk cheesecake blew us away so we ordered a second piece straight away and returned for more many times since.
redditQuotes.source: — amatteroftaste.me · Craft Beer Bars in Saigon guide

places.verdict: The holy grail of craft beer variety in Saigon. BiaCraft boasts the most extensive tap list in the city — their own brews plus Vietnamese and international craft beers. But the real secret weapon? Their legendary salted egg yolk cheesecake. Yes, at a beer bar. And yes, it's extraordinary.

comparison.best for: Maximum variety, pairing beer with salted egg yolk cheesecake, and exploring beyond the big 3 breweries
comparison.must-try: Salted egg yolk cheesecake (non-negotiable), plus whatever's rotating on tap. Their house beers have cheeky names like "Ugly but Vain" and "Let's Get Naked"
comparison.vibe: Casual, friendly, with four locations + a BiaTruck. The District 3 location has a great terrace
comparison.why it made the list: The most extensive craft beer selection in Saigon with 4 locations. Reddit's go-to for variety beyond the big breweries.

places.insiderTip: The most extensive craft beer selection in Saigon with 4 locations. Reddit's go-to for variety beyond the big breweries.
places.editorialSummary: The holy grail of craft beer variety in Saigon. BiaCraft boasts the most extensive tap list in the city — their own brews plus Vietnamese and international craft beers. But the real secret weapon? Their legendary salted egg yolk cheesecake. Yes, at a beer bar. And yes, it's extraordinary.
places.bestFor: Maximum variety, pairing beer with salted egg yolk cheesecake, and exploring beyond the big 3 breweries

places.name: 7 Bridges Craft Beer
places.address: 15B/12 Lê Thánh Tôn, Bến Nghé, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: 7 Bridges was an experimental start up that took the craft beer scene in Vietnam by storm. Established in 2017, they were winning awards and accolades by 2018.

places.verdict: Originally from Da Nang, 7 Bridges stormed the craft beer scene in 2017 and was winning awards by 2018. They use local Vietnamese ingredients like cherry and sakura in creative brews, follow a Zero Waste initiative, and make incredible pizzas and burgers alongside their beer.

comparison.best for: Award-winning experimental beers, eco-conscious drinkers, and craft beer + pizza combos
comparison.must-try: Dragon IPA, Imperial IPA, Cherry Kriek, Sakura Gose
comparison.vibe: Casual taproom + restaurant with a community focus. Open late (until 2 AM)
comparison.why it made the list: Rapid rise from Da Nang startup to multi-city award winner. Zero Waste initiative earns respect. The food menu (pizza, burgers, hot dogs) is genuinely good, not an afterthought.

places.insiderTip: Rapid rise from Da Nang startup to multi-city award winner. Zero Waste initiative earns respect. The food menu (pizza, burgers, hot dogs) is genuinely good, not an afterthought.
places.editorialSummary: Originally from Da Nang, 7 Bridges stormed the craft beer scene in 2017 and was winning awards by 2018. They use local Vietnamese ingredients like cherry and sakura in creative brews, follow a Zero Waste initiative, and make incredible pizzas and burgers alongside their beer.
places.bestFor: Award-winning experimental beers, eco-conscious drinkers, and craft beer + pizza combos

places.name: Belgo Belgian Craft Beer & Restaurant
places.address: 159A Nguyễn Văn Thủ, Đa Kao, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: Belgo: Belgian Craft Brewery — dedicated to creating classic Belgium-style craft beer in HCMC, a hip gastropub with a good happy hour.
redditQuotes.source: — PaleAleTravel · 5 Breweries to Check Out in Ho Chi Minh City

places.verdict: If you prefer Belgian-style brews over American IPAs, Belgo is your spot. A hip gastropub dedicated to classic Belgium-style craft beers with an upscale Western food menu, good happy hour, and a more refined atmosphere than the brewery taprooms.

comparison.best for: Belgian beer styles, gastropub dining, and a more upscale craft beer experience
comparison.must-try: Belgian-style ales, seasonal taps, pair with their Western food menu
comparison.vibe: Hip, polished gastropub. Slightly higher-end than other craft spots. Good happy hour deals
comparison.why it made the list: The Belgian alternative in a scene dominated by American-style IPAs. Consistent quality, strong food pairing options, and a happy hour worth timing your visit around.

places.insiderTip: The Belgian alternative in a scene dominated by American-style IPAs. Consistent quality, strong food pairing options, and a happy hour worth timing your visit around.
places.editorialSummary: If you prefer Belgian-style brews over American IPAs, Belgo is your spot. A hip gastropub dedicated to classic Belgium-style craft beers with an upscale Western food menu, good happy hour, and a more refined atmosphere than the brewery taprooms.
places.bestFor: Belgian beer styles, gastropub dining, and a more upscale craft beer experience

places.name: C-Brewmaster
places.address: 12/4C Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, Đa Kao, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: C-Brewmaster's pho beer — it's a light, thirst-quenching beer with hints of various herbs normally found in pho. Despite sounding off-putting, it does go down really well on humid afternoons.
redditQuotes.source: — amatteroftaste.me · Craft Beer Bars in Saigon guide

places.verdict: The hidden gem of Saigon craft beer. Tucked in a side alley off Bùi Viện, this Hanoi-born brewery's Saigon taproom is tiny but mighty. Their pho beer — yes, a beer flavored with the herbs found in pho — sounds bizarre but is genuinely refreshing on humid afternoons.

comparison.best for: Adventurous drinkers, unique Vietnamese-ingredient beers, intimate taproom vibes
comparison.must-try: Pho beer (herb-infused light ale), dark sticky rice beer, Vietnamese iced coffee beer
comparison.vibe: Tiny, cozy taproom with just a handful of seats. Easy to miss — look for the alley off Bùi Viện
comparison.why it made the list: The most creative and experimental brewery on this list. The pho beer alone is worth the detour. Affordable prices and a genuinely unique experience.

places.insiderTip: The most creative and experimental brewery on this list. The pho beer alone is worth the detour. Affordable prices and a genuinely unique experience.
places.editorialSummary: The hidden gem of Saigon craft beer. Tucked in a side alley off Bùi Viện, this Hanoi-born brewery's Saigon taproom is tiny but mighty. Their pho beer — yes, a beer flavored with the herbs found in pho — sounds bizarre but is genuinely refreshing on humid afternoons.
places.bestFor: Adventurous drinkers, unique Vietnamese-ingredient beers, intimate taproom vibes

places.name: Rooster Beers Taproom
places.address: 40 Bùi Viện, Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: The Chicken Coop and Tiệm Bia Gà Rooster Beers Taproom are two places on Bùi Viện that serve a pretty decent selection of craft beer.

places.verdict: A craft beer oasis on Bùi Viện (backpacker street), where the default is cheap lager. Rooster Beers stands out with a solid craft selection, friendly prices, and the energy of the surrounding nightlife without the chaos.

comparison.best for: Craft beer on backpacker street, budget-friendly craft pints, nightlife-adjacent drinking
comparison.must-try: Rotating local craft taps — ask what's fresh
comparison.vibe: Lively street-facing taproom on Bùi Viện. Good for people-watching with a proper beer
comparison.why it made the list: The best craft beer option on Saigon's famous backpacker street. Good value, good vibes, and a welcome upgrade from the ubiquitous cheap lager.

places.insiderTip: The best craft beer option on Saigon's famous backpacker street. Good value, good vibes, and a welcome upgrade from the ubiquitous cheap lager.

places.bestFor: Craft beer on backpacker street, budget-friendly craft pints, nightlife-adjacent drinking

places.name: Winking Seal Beer Co.
places.address: 50 Đặng Thị Nhu, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: Saigon craft breweries: East West Brewing Company, Heart of Darkness Brewery, Pasteur Street Brewing Company, Winking Seal Beer Co.

places.verdict: A solid, no-nonsense craft brewery that's earned its place in Saigon's top tier. Winking Seal keeps things simple — good beer, fair prices, and a welcoming neighborhood feel. Mentioned alongside the big names in multiple travel and beer guides.

comparison.best for: Laid-back local craft beer without the tourist crowds
comparison.must-try: Their core lineup — clean, well-executed styles
comparison.vibe: Neighborhood brewery feel, less tourist-heavy than the big names
comparison.why it made the list: Consistently mentioned alongside Heart of Darkness, East West, and Pasteur Street in brewery roundups.

places.insiderTip: Consistently mentioned alongside Heart of Darkness, East West, and Pasteur Street in brewery roundups.

redditQuotes.text: Hop CraftBeer is a welcome addition to Bùi Viện. They pour 3T Brewing on draft and carry bottles and cans from the other popular craft breweries in Saigon.

places.verdict: A welcome addition to Bùi Viện's beer scene, Hop CraftBeer pours 3T Brewing on draft and carries bottles and cans from popular Saigon craft breweries. A good spot to sample various local brews in one sitting.

comparison.vibe: Casual Bùi Viện bar — lively and accessible
comparison.why it made the list: Best multi-brewery craft beer selection on backpacker street. Good for a sampler session.

places.name: Bột Craft Beers Rooftop
places.address: 23 Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh, Phường 22, Bình Thạnh

redditQuotes.text: If you're staying in Ho Chi Minh City, come by Bột Craft Beers.
redditQuotes.source: — r/VietNam · Craftbeer scene in VN thread

places.verdict: If you want craft beer with a view, Bột's rooftop spot in Bình Thạnh delivers. Less touristy than the District 1 options, this is where locals go for craft beer and city skyline views. Worth the trip outside the center.

comparison.must-try: Whatever's on tap — the rotating selection is the draw
comparison.vibe: Rooftop with skyline views, chill local crowd, outside the D1 tourist zone
comparison.why it made the list: Reddit-recommended rooftop craft beer spot. The Bình Thạnh location gives a different perspective on Saigon.

places.name: 4P's Pizza (Honorable Mention)

redditQuotes.text: 4P's offers a rotating range of craft beers that pair nicely with their in-house made cheese!

places.verdict: Not a brewery, but an honorable mention for the best craft beer + food pairing in Saigon. 4P's is famous for their in-house made cheese and incredible pizza — and they carry a rotating selection of craft beers that pair perfectly. If you want a full meal with your craft beer, this is the move.

comparison.best for: Pizza + craft beer pairing, dinner that doubles as a beer session
comparison.must-try: Any pizza with in-house cheese + a rotating craft beer
comparison.vibe: Modern pizza restaurant with multiple locations. More food-focused than beer-focused
comparison.why it made the list: Featured in Saigon Food Guide as the best pizza in HCMC. Their rotating craft beer selection pairs brilliantly with the food.

places.insiderTip: Featured in Saigon Food Guide as the best pizza in HCMC. Their rotating craft beer selection pairs brilliantly with the food.
places.editorialSummary: Not a brewery, but an honorable mention for the best craft beer + food pairing in Saigon. 4P's is famous for their in-house made cheese and incredible pizza — and they carry a rotating selection of craft beers that pair perfectly. If you want a full meal with your craft beer, this is the move.
